name: Raiders Breakout
summary:
RAIDERS is a fast-paced VR extraction shooter where every run is a high-stakes mission. Dive into dangerous zones, battle aggressive robots 🤖, loot rare weapons and gear 💎, and escape alive 🚪.

Join Raiders
https://discord.gg/xds4tre3

🎯 Core Gameplay Loop:

Fight ⚔️ – Engage intense VR combat against deadly machines
Loot 💰 – Collect weapons, resources, and rare items
Extract 🚪 – Make it out alive… or risk losing everything

💡 Play Smart:
Every decision matters - go deeper for bigger loot or extract
